cohort.name: ci branch=main builds with state passed or failed and finished_at
cohort.selection: branch=main, build state in [failed, passed], and finished_at present

denominator.unit: terminal job attempts with passed, failed, or soft-fail outcomes

provenance.job_result_source: Buildkite terminal job state and soft_failed flag
provenance.test_duration_source: parsed test-result logs when exact job ID or unique step ID matches
provenance.queue_scope_policy: excluded queues are removed before group and denominator accounting
provenance.observation_schema: normalized build_number/job_id/step_id references; hydrate from builds catalog
provenance.observation_retention: newest eligible reliability observations first, then newest excluded observations

evidence_definitions.mixed_outcome_history: At least one passed and one incident observation in the all-main ci cohort; this is a flaky candidate, not proof that a retry recovered.
evidence_definitions.explicit_retry_recovery: Buildkite retry metadata linking a failed attempt to a passed retry.
evidence_definitions.terminal_history: Only passed, hard-failed, or soft-failed jobs count in the denominator.

provenance.evidence_kind: explicit Buildkite retry metadata retained by the collector

latest_test_group_counts.count_basis: unique logical test-group identities observed in this build; when its commit matches the pinned AMD definitions, verified source step identity or normalized label plus agent pool resolves the configuration identity family, preserving topology-distinct routes; hardware-specific executions in one family and configured %N shard jobs count once per family; without an aligned map they fall back to the normalized group; configured-definition inventories are separate

test_results.role: parsed test counts, statuses, and duration only

nightly_metadata.role: authoritative Buildkite terminal job outcome and timing

logical_test_groups.role: same-build normalized logical test-group totals and any-hardware passing counts

classification.soft: analytics job state is soft_fail/soft_failed or soft_failed is true
classification.hard: analytics job state is failed, timed_out, broken, or canceled
classification.unknown: analytics job state is missing, skipped, or non-terminal
classification.jsonl_status_role: test-count enrichment only; never the terminal group outcome
